# Melih Arık

> Melih Arık is a software engineer based in Tallinn, Estonia. He works as a Mobile Engineer at Omniva on logistics apps (Crowd App, Omnihub) and has shipped 30+ indie apps to the App Store and Google Play using SwiftUI, Flutter, React Native and Kotlin. He is pursuing an MSc in Software Engineering at the University of Tartu.

## About

- Role: Software Engineer (mobile focus: iOS, Android, cross-platform)
- Company: Omniva (Baltic logistics), Tallinn, Estonia — since Feb 2026
- Education: MSc Software Engineering, University of Tartu (2025–present); BSc Computer Engineering, Bursa Uludağ University (2019–2024)
- Skills: Swift, SwiftUI, Kotlin, Java, Flutter, Dart, React Native, Firebase, Spring Boot
- Open to freelance work: https://cal.com/meliharik

## Selected projects

- [Beatzy — AI music maker iOS app](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatzy-ai-music-generator/id6742488919): SwiftUI + Node.js, reached Top 100 on the App Store
- [Portman](https://github.com/meliharik/portman): native macOS menu bar app to inspect and kill processes listening on ports, distributed via Homebrew
- [Tartu Smart Bike Mobility Analysis](https://github.com/meliharik/tartu-bike-analysis): data analysis of 19,500 bike-sharing trips and 1.5M GPS points
- [Real-Time Geo-Fencing Engine](https://github.com/meliharik/realtime_geo_fencing_service): Spring Boot + PostGIS + Redis service processing scooter GPS streams in real time

## Research

- "Encrypted Messaging Application Combining AES and RSA Algorithms" — ICETI'24, first author
